## animation.createController

Creates an animation controller asset (.stanimator): parameters, states (each plays an animation clip), transitions between them (conditions on parameters, exit times, cross-fades) and events, which an Animator component plays (its Controller property). Returns the new asset and its content as animation.info describes it.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `animation` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAnimationCommands.cpp:153`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultState` | string | no |   | The state the animator starts in (default: the first state). |
| `parameters` | array | no |   | Parameters: \[{&quot;Name&quot;, &quot;Type&quot;: &quot;Float&quot; \| &quot;Bool&quot; \| &quot;Trigger&quot;, &quot;Default&quot;: number or bool}\]. |
| `path` | string | yes |   | Path relative to the asset directory, e.g. &quot;Animations/Hero.stanimator&quot;. |
| `states` | array | yes |   | States: \[{&quot;Name&quot;, &quot;Clip&quot;: animation clip handle (animation.info lists a model's clips) or null for the rest pose, &quot;Speed&quot; (default 1, negative plays backwards), &quot;Loop&quot; (default true), &quot;Events&quot;: \[{&quot;Name&quot;, &quot;Time&quot;: seconds into the clip}\]}\]. |
| `transitions` | array | no |   | Transitions, tested after every update in order (from any state first): \[{&quot;From&quot;: state name, or &quot;AnyState&quot;: true (with &quot;CanTransitionToSelf&quot;), &quot;To&quot;, &quot;Conditions&quot;: \[{&quot;Parameter&quot;, &quot;Mode&quot;: &quot;Greater&quot; \| &quot;Less&quot; (floats, with &quot;Threshold&quot;) \| &quot;True&quot; \| &quot;False&quot; (bools) \| &quot;Set&quot; (triggers, consumed when it fires)}\], &quot;ExitTime&quot;: the source state's normalized time to wait for (null: none), &quot;Duration&quot;: cross-fade seconds}\]. |

## animation.info

Describes animation data. asset: a model (its skeleton and animation clips with names, durations and joints), a skeleton (its joints and parents), an animation clip (duration and channels) or an animation controller (parameters, states with their clips, transitions). entity: an entity's Animator (its assets and, while the scene plays, the current state, normalized time, whether it blends and the parameter values).

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `animation` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAnimationCommands.cpp:218`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset` | string | no |   | A model, skeleton, animation clip or animation controller: handle or path (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |
| `entity` | string | no |   | An entity with an Animator component (instead of asset) (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |

<details>
<summary>Parameter schema of animation.info</summary>

## animation.preview

Shows an animator of the edited scene posed while the scene does not play (the viewport and viewport.capture show it, skinned meshes and the parts attached to joints alike), without changing the scene: a state of its controller, a clip, or what it plays on start, at a time in seconds. Answers once this request's pose is shown (its assets loaded). stop: true ends the entity's preview (or every preview without an entity).

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `animation` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAnimationCommands.cpp:286`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clip` | string | no |   | An animation clip to show instead of a state (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |
| `entity` | string | no |   | An entity with an Animator component (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `state` | string | no |   | A state of the animator's controller (default: what it plays on start). |
| `stop` | boolean | no |   | End the preview instead. |
| `time` | number | no |   | Seconds into the state or clip (default 0). |

## animation.setController

Replaces parts of an animation controller asset of the project: the given sections (parameters, states, defaultState, transitions; each replaces the whole list) while the others stay. One undo step; animators and previews use the new controller at once. Returns its content.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `animation` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAnimationCommands.cpp:187`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | string | yes |   | The animation controller: handle or path (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |
| `defaultState` | string | no |   | The state the animator starts in (default: the first state). |
| `parameters` | array | no |   | Parameters: \[{&quot;Name&quot;, &quot;Type&quot;: &quot;Float&quot; \| &quot;Bool&quot; \| &quot;Trigger&quot;, &quot;Default&quot;: number or bool}\]. |
